definition.def: An estate is a large area of land in the country which is owned by a person, family, or organization.
examples: ...a shooting party on Lord Wyville's estate in Yorkshire.

definition.def: People sometimes use estate to refer to a housing estate or an industrial estate. [British]
examples: He used to live on the estate.

definition.def: Someone's estate is all the money and property that they leave behind them when they die. [law]
An estate is the same as an estate car. [British]
